create_ImagenetteConfig: create an ImagenetteConfig builder config with a specified size and base variant
build_Builder_dataset: build an Imagenette GeneratorBasedBuilder dataset with train and validation splits
run_Builder_info: run the Builder _info method to get dataset features, labels, and supervised keys
run_Builder_splits: run the Builder _split_generators method to download and extract imagenette data archives
run_Builder_generate: run the Builder _generate_examples method to yield image and label records from a datapath
